crossRefs.note: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.
Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward the sky, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even…
He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of…
who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.
He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.
lightning and hail, snow and clouds; stormy wind, fulfilling his word;
When neither sun nor stars shone on us for many days, and no small storm pressed on us, all hope that we would be saved…

translations.web: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.
translations.bsb: He fills His hands with lightning and commands it to strike its mark.
translations.kjv: With clouds he covereth the light; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt.
translations.asv: He covereth his hands with the lightning, And giveth it a charge that it strike the mark.
